title: finance-budget-planning-1on1-prep
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep — Priya Kumar (Finance Dir) / Maya Patel (Finance Manager)
Date: 2026-03-05 (scheduled 10:00am)
Location: Zoom / quick sync before Exec review
Purpose: Align on current run-rate, outstanding procurement approvals, and items to surface at the leadership budget review next week.

Quick summary notes (one-liners):
- Current committed run-rate (monthly cash out): ~ $555k/mo (cloud + infra + third-party ops) — see breakout below.
- Q2 incremental asks: +$120k/mo (predominantly additional Dedicated GPU reserve and higher SSO/SCIM enterprise seats).
- Procurement approvals pending: GPU reserved capacity (Augment dedicated pool), Datadog retention increase, Contract addendum for labeling vendor.
- Risks to call out: spike in inference egress costs from EMEA/Asia pilot, hiring push for infra engineers, potential FY spend creep if Dedicated autoscale not tightened.

Run-rate breakout (estimates):
- Cloud compute (hosted API + burst infra): $320,000 / mo
- Dedicated reserved infra (current commitments): $150,000 / mo
- Third-party services (SaaS: Datadog, Sentry, Stripe fees, labelers): $40,000 / mo
- Licenses / procurement (KMS, security tooling): $25,000 / mo
- Misc (travel, legal, one-off projects): $20,000 / mo
= Total ~ $555k/mo (~$6.66M annualized)

Q2 asks detail (to present):
1) Dedicated GPU reserve increase — Request: +4 A100-equivalent slots (3yr reserved term preferred).
   - Impact: +~$85k/mo committed (but lowers per-token cost vs on-demand).
   - Rationale: Upcoming enterprise deals require sustained throughput and isolation; current Dedicated SLOs possible breakpoints.
   - Decision needed: Exec approval + Procurement trigger (PO) before 03/18 to hit vendor timelines.
2) Datadog log retention bump (30 -> 90 days) for model telemetry audits.
   - Impact: +$12k/mo incremental.
   - Risk if denied: slower investigations, potential non-compliance for SOC2 customers.
3) Labeling vendor top-up (3 months) for safety evals.
   - Impact: ~$23k one-time + possible recurring retainer.

Procurement status snapshot (who to nudge):
- GPU reserve: Request submitted to Procurement (ticket PR-789), approver: Priya Kumar -> waiting on Alex Rivera (infra) final signoff.
- Datadog: Renewal amendment in legal queue (LEGAL-421) — need security cost signoff from Lina (Security).
- Labeling vendor: SOW draft sent; vendor asked for PO; need C-level signoff for >$20k one-off.

Agenda for the 1:1 (30 min):
1) Quick run-rate review (5 min) — confirm numbers above + any anomalies since last update.
2) Review of Q2 incremental asks (10 min) — focus on GPU reserve ask + justification and procurement timeline.
3) Approval blockers (5 min) — legal, security, exec priorities; who to escalate to.
4) Action items & next steps (10 min) — assign owners and due dates; schedule follow-ups.

Notes / talking points for Priya:
- Emphasize long-term savings from reserved capacity vs on-demand for our top enterprise customers — show simple TCO slide (I will bring numbers).
- Ask infra to model latency vs cost with/without the extra reserved slots (SLA implications).
- Suggest staggered procurement: approve minimal commit now (2 slots) to mitigate risk, remainder contingent on signing deal X.

Potential pushback & counter-arguments:
- "We can't commit more without revenue visibility" -> Counter: structure as staged reserve with option to scale down; include charge-back to Dedicated customers.
- "Datadog cost too high" -> Counter: propose cost-neutral telemetry optimization (filters + metrics-only retention) but keep 90d for security-critical logs.

Action items (owners & rough due dates):
- Maya: prepare TCO slide comparing reserved vs on-demand for 4 slots; include payback calc. Due: 2026-03-06.
- Alex Rivera: run infra simulation for latency/cost with extra reserved capacity; provide results. Due: 2026-03-10.
- Priya: escalate GPU PO to Exec approval channel and confirm approver list. Due: 2026-03-05 (end of day).
- Lina (Security): confirm Datadog retention acceptable for SOC2; if not, propose mitigations. Due: 2026-03-08.
- Procurement team: draft PO template for GPU reserve with staged commitment language. Due: 2026-03-09.

Follow-ups to schedule:
- Quick sync w/ Alex + Maya after infra sim (15-20m) — target 2026-03-11.
- Leadership budget review: present Q2 asks (Priya + Maya) — 2026-03-16 agenda slot requested.

Misc notes / scratchpad:
- Check Jira BUD-1427 for historical reserved deals and actual utilization (do we have 70% utilization baseline?).
- Confirm whether Datadog overage is being charged monthly or invoiced quarterly.
- Consider short-term burst policy: enable limited on-demand burst for peak traffic to avoid missed SLAs while reserve spins up.

Questions for Priya in meeting:
- Are we comfortable with 3-year reserved term vs 1-year with option? (I prefer 3yr for price but exec risk higher.)
- Any execs specifically sensitive to long-term commitments? (list likely: CFO, Head of Sales).

Draft email to execs (to review live):
"Quick note — Priya and I are requesting approval for a modest increase in Dedicated reserved capacity and telemetry retention to support near-term enterprise deals. We will present TCO and risk mitigation steps on 3/16. If anyone prefers a pre-brief, happy to schedule a 15m call. — Maya"

End of notes.
short_description: 1:1 prep notes for finance run-rate review, procurement approvals, and action items
